We have applied 29646 to target, got product(s). The apply_template returned three possible precursors (tuples). The result is a tuple of strings? It gave three strings: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'

3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C'

Actually the tuple shows three strings, maybe each is a possible precursor set? Usually apply_template returns list of precursor SMILES strings (multiple reactants). But here each entry seems a single SMILES? Might be each is a product of applying reverse? Not sure.

We need to construct a route: start from target, apply template 29646 to get precursors (maybe a set). Then apply 1914389 to each appropriate precursor, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to retrieve templates 149040 and 1914391.
